reports.title: auto_parameters picks a recent time_range for queries about a past month
reports.did: 72 searches with auto_parameters: true, a query naming a month in Jan–Sep 2026, and max_results only (no dates)
reports.happened: auto_parameters chose time_range w 57, d 14, m 1; 620 of 659 results were dated October 2026 and 38 were undated
reports.expected: a time_range that covers the month the query names, or none, with a note that a historical query needs start_date/end_date
reports.fix: when the query names a past month, return no time_range (or that month's window); document the default
reports.evidence: 620 of 659 results from October 2026, 72 searches; Tavily request IDs logged for 31 of 72 searches, e.g. `73a3cac7-ae69-4e16-847d-726c5baec6c3`, `22b874a7-56ab-4d36-b4f6-73c737b18e62`; files `v2/ablation/arm_T_*.json` (plan[].auto_parameters, cards[].published)

reports.title: With explicit dates, auto_parameters still reports a time_range
reports.did: 56 searches with auto_parameters: true plus our start_date/end_date (arm T+dates, exploratory)
reports.happened: the auto_parameters echo in the response reported time_range w 47, d 8, y 1, and a start_date or end_date in 0 of 56 echoes; yet 532 of 532 dated results fell inside our window, so the dates were applied
reports.expected: the echo shows the window actually applied (our start_date/end_date)
reports.fix: echo start_date/end_date, or drop time_range from the echo, when the caller sends dates
reports.evidence: 532 of 532 dated results inside the window, 56 searches; Tavily request IDs logged for 47 of 56 searches, e.g. `0e8e93b5-57d6-49a7-b1bf-204b2c6f4249`, `e63b56ba-9a8c-407a-acbc-215c66d4dcce`; files `v2/ablation/arm_Td_*.json` (plan[].auto_parameters, plan[].dates_kept)

reports.title: Extract has no as-of view, so Search dates do not freeze page content
reports.did: 14 finance-check searches with start_date/end_date and filter_by_published_date, then a separate, post-hoc AI-assisted review (ChatGPT agent) of every result page (146 of 283 rows stayed unclear)
reports.happened: 0 of 14 searches returned a result dated after the cutoff, yet 1 page's current version leaks the outcome: R196 was dated 2026-07-07 by Tavily (cutoff 2026-07-08) and updated on 2026-07-09 with a link to the actual result
reports.expected: a way for a time-locked user to read, or at least detect, the page as it was on the cutoff
reports.fix: an as-of / crawl-date field on Extract (the date of the copy returned), or an as_of parameter
reports.evidence: 1 of 67 filtered result pages; R196 from the search with request ID `dce7e851-b012-4dfe-84d4-ea43b27b1bd9` (response SHA-256 `a509b8bc8a346701…`); file `results/timelock34_second_review.json` (finance_filtered.example)

reports.title: Separate original-publication and last-modified dates
reports.did: compared, by code, Tavily's published_date with the page's own published/updated date on the 42 distinct date-test pages that had both
reports.happened: 4 had a later published_date (3 by more than 7 days; largest gap 345 days)
reports.expected: nothing different: this is consistent with Tavily's documented definition of published_date (published or last updated, beta)
reports.fix: return original-publication and last-modified dates as two fields, and let the date filter choose

reports.title: Map returns empty results silently
reports.did: Map on the 5 sites of our official crawl list and 7 dairy sites, with and without instructions
reports.happened: empty results with no failed_results and no error on 5 sites of the official crawl list (merc, derc, uperc, iocl, amul) and 3 dairy sites (aavin, nandini-kmf, sanchi-indore (MPCDF union)); without instructions also empty on merc, derc, uperc, iocl; a bad start URL did get a clear error (sanchi-mpcdf)
reports.expected: an empty answer that says why (blocked, robots, nothing matched)
reports.fix: a reason field on empty Map/Crawl responses

reports.title: One scanned PDF: Extract returned the letterhead but not the image-only rates
reports.did: Extract (basic and advanced) on one scanned dairy rate-list PDF (Gokul)
reports.happened: 607 characters of letterhead; the rates are an image and did not come back
reports.expected: OCR of image-only PDF pages, or a flag that the text layer is empty
reports.fix: an ocr option, or an 'image_only' flag on the result

reports.title: /usage lags per-call usage
reports.did: compared GET /usage with the per-call include_usage credits the same day
reports.happened: /usage reported plan_usage 6 while per-call include_usage credits added up to 226
reports.expected: /usage close to the sum of per-call usage
reports.fix: update /usage within minutes, or document the lag

nebius.title: Nano gives no number where Super finds one on the same page
nebius.did: Nano read each fetched page; where it gave no number, Super re-read the page (63 saved arm and evidence files)
nebius.happened: Super re-read 1692 pages and found a verified number (the number is in the cited line) on 43 of them
nebius.expected: a number whenever the cited line states one
nebius.fix: a schema-level 'required number when a currency or % is present' hint, or a confidence field
